Every site is a lone-\b or single-\b...\b-bracket shape — never a chain of two or more \b-anchored subexpressions separated by a wildcard run — matching the shape rule the bisection evidence establishes as unaffected. No file was edited. This independently reconfirms report Finding 1 (engine split) and Finding 5 (ugrep-exposed sites).
